```{ojs}
//| label: dr-setup
//| output: false

import { classRes, drugRes, mutRes, subtypeCounts, cutoff, linelist } from "_data.qmd"

// Raw Arquero tables from imported row-level data
drClassRaw = aq.table(classRes)
drDrugRaw = aq.table(drugRes)
drMutRaw = aq.table(mutRes)

// Unique options for checkboxes
drClassOptions = drClassRaw.dedupe("class").array("class").sort()
drDrugOptions = drDrugRaw.dedupe("drug").array("drug").sort()
drMutOptions = drMutRaw.dedupe("mutation").array("mutation").sort()

```

# Drug Resistance

## {.toolbar}

```{ojs}
//| label: dr-time-bin
viewof drTimeBin = Inputs.radio(
  new Map([
    ["Half-year", "half-year"],
    ["Year", "year"],
    ["Custom before/after", "split"]
  ]),
  { value: "half-year", label: "Time binning" }
)

```

```{ojs}
//| label: dr-split-date
viewof drSplitDate = {
  if (drTimeBin === "split") {
    return Inputs.date({ label: "Split at:", value: cutoff })
  }
  const span = document.createElement("span")
  span.value = null
  return span
}
```

```{ojs}
//| label: dr-bin-apply-date-bins
//| output: false

// Apply time binning to each dataset.
// Convert to object to avoid calling bindDate twice to define period & period_label
drClassBinned = {
  return aq.from(drClassRaw.objects().map(d => {
    const bin = binDate(d.date_onset, drTimeBin, drSplitDate)
    return { ...d, period: bin.period, period_label: bin.period_label }
  }))
}

drDrugBinned = {
  return aq.from(drDrugRaw.objects().map(d => {
    const bin = binDate(d.date_onset, drTimeBin, drSplitDate)
    return { ...d, period: bin.period, period_label: bin.period_label }
  }))
}

drMutBinned = {
  return aq.from(drMutRaw.objects().map(d => {
    const bin = binDate(d.date_onset, drTimeBin, drSplitDate)
    return { ...d, period: bin.period, period_label: bin.period_label }
  }))
}

// Total sequences per period (denominator for res-rates).
// Could be pre-computed in R if performance is an issue.
drDenominators = {
  return aq.from(
    aq.table(linelist).objects().map(d => {
      const bin = binDate(d.date_onset, drTimeBin, drSplitDate)
      return { period: bin.period, period_label: bin.period_label }
    })
  )
  .groupby("period", "period_label")
  .rollup({ total: d => op.count() })
}

// Unique period options for min period selector
drPeriods = drClassBinned
  .select("period", "period_label")
  .dedupe()
  .orderby("period")

drPeriodLabels = drPeriods.array("period_label")
drPeriodValues = drPeriods.array("period")
```

```{ojs}
//| label: dr-min-period

viewof drMinPeriod = Inputs.select(
  new Map(drPeriodLabels.map((l, i) => [l, drPeriodValues[i]])),
  {
    value: drPeriodValues.length > 10 ?
      drPeriodValues[drPeriodValues.length - 10] :
      drPeriodValues[0],
    label: "Show data since"
  }
)
```

```{ojs}
//| label: dr-aggregate
//| output: false

// Class: sum "resistant" per clas/period group
drClassAgg = drClassBinned
  .groupby("period", "period_label", "class")
  .rollup({ n: d => op.sum(d.resistant) })
  .orderby("period", "period_label", "class")

// Drug: sum "resistant" per drug/period group
drDrugAgg = drDrugBinned
  .groupby("period", "period_label", "drug")
  .rollup({ n: d => op.sum(d.resistant) })
  .orderby("period", "period_label", "drug")

// Mutation: count rows per mutation/period group
drMutAgg = drMutBinned
  .groupby("period", "period_label", "mutation")
  .rollup({ n: d => op.count() })
  .orderby("period", "period_label", "mutation")

// Ordered period labels for plot facet domains
drLabelOrder = drPeriods
  .filter(aq.escape(d => d.period >= drMinPeriod))
  .array("period_label")
```

## {.tabset}

### Class

#### {.sidebar}

```{ojs}
//| label: dr-class-form
viewof drClassForm = Inputs.form({
  barMode: Inputs.radio(["Grouped", "Stacked"], { label: "Bar mode", value: "Grouped" }),
  selected: Inputs.checkbox(drClassOptions, { value: drClassOptions, label: "Select classes" })
})
```

```{ojs}
//| label: dr-class-filter
//| output: false

drClassCurrent = {
  const selected = drClassForm.selected
  return drClassAgg
    .filter(aq.escape(d => d.period >= drMinPeriod))
    .filter(aq.escape(d => selected.includes(d.class)))
}
```

#### Row
##### Class barplot {height="62.5%"}

```{ojs}
//| label: dr-class-barplot
//| expandable: true

{
  if (drClassCurrent.numRows() === 0) return noData("No data to display.", { height: "200px" })

  let data = drClassCurrent
    .join(drDenominators.select("period", "total"), "period")
    .derive({ prop: d => d.total != null ? d.n / d.total : 0 })
    .objects()

  // Apply table selection input
  const tableData = drClassTableSelection
  const allSelected = !tableData || tableData.length === 0
  if (!allSelected) {
    const selectedPeriods = new Set(tableData.map(d => d.period_label))
    data = data.filter(d => selectedPeriods.has(d.period_label))
  }

  const grouped = drClassForm.barMode === "Grouped"

  return Plot.plot({
    fx: { label: "Period", tickRotate: 0, padding: 0.1, domain: drLabelOrder },
    x: grouped ?
      { axis: null, padding: 0.05, domain: drClassForm.selected } :
      { axis: null },
    y: { label: "% Sequences per time-bin", percent: true },
    color: { legend: true, ...colorScales["resistance_class"] },
    style: { background: "transparent", color: "currentColor" }, // Registers darkmode
    marks: [
      grouped
        ? Plot.barY(data, {
            fx: "period_label", x: "class", y: "prop", fill: "class", tip: true,
            title: d => `${d.class}\n${d.period_label}\n${d.n}/${d.total} (${(d.prop * 100).toFixed(1)}%)`
          })
        : Plot.barY(data, Plot.stackY({
            fx: "period_label", y: "prop", fill: "class", tip: true,
            title: d => `${d.class}\n${d.period_label}\n${d.n}/${d.total} (${(d.prop * 100).toFixed(1)}%)`
          })),
      Plot.ruleY([0])
    ],
    height: 300
  })
}
```


##### Class table {height="37.5%"}

```{ojs}
//| label: dr-class-table

viewof drClassTableSelection = {
  if (drClassCurrent.numRows() === 0) return noData("No data to display.")

  const selected = drClassForm.selected
  const wide = drClassCurrent
    .groupby("period_label")
    .pivot("class", "n")
    .derive({
      total: aq.escape(d => selected.reduce((sum, c) => sum + (d[c] || 0), 0))
    })
    .orderby("period_label")

  return Inputs.table(wide.objects(), {
    rows: 15,
    layout: "auto",
    sort: "period_label",
    reverse: true,
    header: {
      period_label: "Period",
      total: "Total"
    }
  })
}
```
